keyFindings.description: Round-6 item 2 in the opposite order, still open (present at 106f21e5 too; reproduced by the deep reviewer with a real awareness and the beforeAwarenessRecord hook): a heartbeat's observer reads Meta = c+1 and records late; a removal of X at c+1 records first (local deleted, batch[X] = removal); the late state record finds X unlisted, so it relists X at c+1 and sets batch[X] = nil (:425-431); resolve drops X as not live (:516-524). The removal is never sent, the other processes keep the cursor until the 30 s expiry, and local keeps a client that left. Fix: settle a state entry for an unlisted client by awarenessClientStanding as an answer's is (drop it when not live); one rule by entry kind removes the answered parameter. Test: hold the heartbeat's record until after the removal's, failing first.

Comments that say more than the code does: the local field (:232-236) and record (:336-338) say a stale state is settled by reading the room, but :421-424 does no read; resolve (:497-498) and record (:360-361) assume a removal stays in the batch, which item 1 contradicts.
Dead store at :416 (entry.clock = held on the range copy).

Test comments :501 and :588 say a stale state reaching bob after the removal 'is dropped there'; the receiver purges tombstones after every inbound apply (awareness_relay.go:719-721), so it would be taken as a new client.
The file grows from 824 to 1,115 lines; move the race tests (:245-778) into awareness_relay_race_test.go.

TestARoomsAwarenessFiresItsObserversWithItsLockReleased (:710-760) catches observers fired under ygo's write lock only; an observer fired under a read lock would pass it and deadlock once a writer queues. Say so in its comment, or have the observer wait on a write.

verified: Round-6 item 1 closed: a listed client's clock is never lowered (answers use max(clock, held) at :406; a stale state leaves local alone at :421-424).
Round-6 item 2 closed for the order it named (:412-418): a stale removal is settled by one read of the room under r.mu.

Lock order: the only ygo call under r.mu is EncodeUpdate's read lock (awarenessClientStanding); every ygo path that fires observers releases its lock first (SetLocalState :266-275, Heartbeat :308-312, ApplyUpdate :724-733, RemoveExpired :851-858); no relay path takes ygo's lock and then r.mu.

No removal is decided from two reads: touched marks the entry from one snapshot, record's single read under r.mu alone decides live or not; answer and resolve read twice but decide no removal. The window-1 test and beforeAwarenessRemovalRead are fully gone.
Comments at former :221 and :690 corrected. The three window tests share aReturnRacingARemoval; new tests fail at 106f21e5 with only the answer hook added (tester).
